name: constant-type-test-27d6dffc1c/constant-type-negative-e.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: Mapping constructor — Currently [spread-field](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#spread-field) not supported
reason: The case essentially uses unsupported mapping spread fields in constant initializers: CMS1_CLONE = {...CMS1} and CMS12_CLONE = {...CMS1, ...CMS2}. It also asserts rejection of the latter and uses the resulting constant types in further negative checks. The explicit spread-field restriction makes the whole case a feature case despite supported constant declarations and other type-error checks.
unsupported_constructs: Mapping spread fields in CMS1_CLONE and CMS12_CLONE constant initializers.
test_design_notes: Compile-time negative case with @error assertions; no @args, @panic, or @output directives.
